record.question: How can the patency of an IV line be confirmed before administering contrast with a power injector?
options: Injecting a trial dose of the contrast agent.
Flushing the line with saline and observing for swelling or resistance.
Relying on the computer system to detect a blockage.
Asking the patient if they feel any pain.
record.explanation: Answer B: Flushing the line with saline and observing for swelling or resistance.. A saline flush with observation for resistance, pain or swelling helps assess line patency before power injection under local protocol. Source/context note: Use only under local injector/contrast protocol; patency verification method depends on access type and policy. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/bodyct; https://www.acr.org/Clinical-Resources/Clinical-Tools-and-Reference/Contrast-Manual. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
